proposals.evidence: DEDR4616 explicitly labels Konda magavaṇḍu man/husband as borrowed from Telugu and attests Telugu magavā̃ḍu man/male/hero. The existing Telugu dictionary attestation f_4jhrmayewlfbc is therefore the proposed immediate donor for survey Konda mogavaṇḍru man, with source vowel and plural/honorific -ru retained. No new donor node is created.

proposals.evidence: DEDR4869 gives Konda mili evening/night and Gondi mulpe/mult evening beside mul- become evening. Survey mili/mulipe/mulpe/mulpat(i) responses retain that attested evening family, with source night versus evening/afternoon glosses unchanged. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1977(a) lists Tamil cevi, Alu Kurumba kevi, Kannada kivi/kimi/kemi, Gondi kevi/kavi, Parji/Gadaba kekol, Konda gibi, Kurukh xebdā and Brahui xaf ‘ear’. The separate Kui/Kuvi kri- subsection (b) is not folded into this analysis; deafness derivatives are excluded. User clarified on 2026-09-21 that each DEDR node represents the whole dictionary article, not only the displayed reconstruction. The head label remains unchanged; the cited article family/subsection is the proposed parent scope. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
